name: Summer Academy high school camps
org: Wayne State University, Anderson College of Engineering
what_you_do: Spend a week on campus on real projects in coding, design, construction and game development. Special camps cover construction management, smart agriculture and aviation careers.
who_can_apply: Students going into grades 9 to 12. Choose camp I or II of a topic, not both.
pay_detail: Price not on the pages read. A scholarships page is listed.
duration: 1 week per camp. You can mix topics across weeks.
deadline_text: The page says all summer 2026 sessions are complete. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Register through the Summer Academy pages. Use the question link to reach the Director of Community Engagement.
